brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Something to keep sewing supplies tidy (a storage organiser that holds small items in separate places)
requirements.evidence: Built one Hex base (piece at 0,0,0, full variant) with a full-depth 3-compartment bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3) dropped into its cell. check_build is ok with meshClash clear. The organiser has three separate compartments for spools, needles, buttons and similar. It is a single cell, not a larger wall system, and I did not add sewing-specific props: the catalogue has no sewing items (no scissors, thread or pins), and the tools it does have are for workshop and electronics use.

finish.summary: A single hex base with a three-compartment tray, verified clear of mesh collisions. It is a small, simple tidy-up unit. The catalogue has no sewing-specific props, so none were added. Material and durability are not checked by the configurator.
